description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Magnus Smith Trap. Play 9.Ng5! against 8...Nge7 and punish castling with 10.Qh5!.

drills.briefExplanation: 9.Ng5! O-O?? 10.Qh5! h6 11.Nxe6 — the threats of mate and the fork can't both be met.
drills.description: White to play. Black played the passive 8...Nge7 — strike with the Magnus Smith 9.Ng5!.
drills.explanation: The Magnus Smith Trap: 9.Ng5! hits e6 and prepares Qh5. If Black castles with 9...O-O??, White plays 10.Qh5! with a crushing attack — and after 10...h6 11.Nxe6! the knight forks queen and rook while the mate threat persists. Black's 8...Nge7 was too slow; the Morra initiative punishes every tempo lost.
drills.name: The Ng5 Strike

drills.briefExplanation: 10.Nxf7! Kxf7 11.Qh5+ — the Greek Gift sacrifice crashes through.
drills.description: White to play. Black tried 9...h6?? — sacrifice the knight Greek-Gift style.
drills.explanation: 9...h6?? tries to kick the knight but walks into a classic: 10.Nxf7! Kxf7 11.Qh5+ — the Greek Gift sacrifice. Black's king is dragged into the open, White's bishops (c4 raking f7, c1 joining via d2) create a mating net, and Black's extra piece is meaningless. Never weaken the kingside in front of a Morra attack.
drills.name: The Greek Gift
